sloka: देश कालौ भजस्व अद्य क्षममाणः प्रिय अप्रिये ।सुख दुःख सहः काले सुग्रीव वशगो भव ॥४-२२-२०॥
transliteration: deśa kālau bhajasva adya kṣamamāṇaḥ priya apriye ।sukha duḥkha sahaḥ kāle sugrīva vaśago bhava ॥4-22-20॥

translations.english: 'Enduring pleasure or pain equally with due regard to time and place favourable to you or otherwise, you should submit to the will of Sugriva.
